# Issuu

> Issuu is a digital publishing platform that transforms PDFs into interactive flipbooks with advanced content distribution, engagement, and monetization tools.

Issuu enables creators, designers, publishers, and marketers to convert static documents into engaging interactive publications with features like flipbooks, social sharing, analytics, and direct sales capabilities. The platform supports seamless integration with design tools like Canva and Adobe InDesign, and marketing platforms like HubSpot.

## Key Topics

- Flipbooks
- PDF Conversion
- Interactive Content
- Digital Publishing
- Content Distribution
- Digital Sales
- Social Posts
- Articles
- QR Codes
- Analytics & Statistics
- Team Collaboration
- Embed Integration
- Content Monetization
- Reader Engagement
- Fullscreen Sharing

## Core Publishing Features

- [Flipbook | Interactive Flipbook Maker to Convert PDFs](https://issuu.com/features/flipbooks): Core flipbook feature converting PDFs to interactive animations with QR codes.
- [Elevate any document with Issuu's interactive features](https://issuu.com/features): Main features page showcasing all interactive document publishing and marketing tools.
- [Captivate viewers with Fullscreen Sharing | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/fullscreen-sharing): Fullscreen sharing feature providing immersive reading experience for flipbooks.
- [Maximize content visibility with no-code Embed | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/embed): No-code embed feature for integrating PDFs into WordPress, Squarespace, and Wix.

## Content Marketing & Distribution

- [Reach a wider audience with mobile Articles | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/articles): AI-powered mobile article generation for content marketing and SEO optimization.
- [Boost engagement with Social Posts | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/social-posts): Drag-and-drop social media post builder for Facebook, Instagram multi-channel publishing.
- [Generate buzz with customizable GIFs | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/gifs): GIF generator converting PDFs to animated content for social and email marketing.
- [Simplify content sharing with QR Codes | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/qr-codes): QR code generator for mobile-friendly content sharing and contactless access.

## Engagement & Monetization

- [Turn pages into profits with Digital Sales | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/digital-sales): Monetization feature enabling flipbook sales via Stripe payment processing.
- [Make data-driven decisions with Statistics | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/statistics): Analytics dashboard tracking flipbook, article, and social post performance metrics.
- [Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/add-links): Interactive link feature adding clickable, shoppable links to PDFs for engagement.
- [Ignite your content with Videos | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/video): Video embedding feature linking YouTube and Vimeo videos in PDF publications.

## Team Collaboration & Integration

- [Work better together with Teams | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/teams): Team collaboration feature for managing content library and distribution globally.
- [Capture and convert leads with Issuu content on HubSpot | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/hubspot-integration): HubSpot integration for lead generation and marketing automation with flipbooks.

## Design Tool Integration Guides

- [Canva flipbooks, made with Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/canva-to-flipbook): Guide for creating flipbooks from Canva designs using Issuu's publishing platform.
- [Turn InDesign creations into interactive assets | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/indesign-export-to-flipbook): Tutorial for exporting Adobe InDesign files to dynamic PDF flipbooks.
- [Go from Adobe Express creation to Issuu publication | Issuu](https://issuu.com/features/adobe-express-to-flipbook): Guide for converting Adobe Express designs to interactive Issuu flipbooks.

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse Categories | Issuu](https://issuu.com/categories): Browse digital publications across categories including magazines, newspapers, and books.
- [Immersive flipbooks bring your designs to life | Issuu](https://issuu.com/industry/art-and-design): Industry-specific page for designers and architects showcasing portfolio flipbooks.
